ns2:section.sectionText: Thinking of turning your passion for sports and entertainment into a viable career? Here is a chance to network and meet with premier athletic organizations, media companies, and advertising agencies. Experience Portland, Oregon to learn about the culture and careers from industry professionals as well as cutting-edge and emerging organizations. Potential visits include: Nike, Adidas, Under Armor, Columbia Sportswear, Patagonia, Portland Timbers & Trailblazers, Wieden + Kennedy, and more. Trip Date: May 15 - 20, 2017. * Application: https://illinois.edu/fb/sec/2954890 * Apply by: 2/17/2017 * Notified of acceptance by: 3/3/2017 * Commit to the course by: 3/10/2017 * Course Fee: $1,550 (billed to your student account). Scholarships and financial aid can be applied.
